Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in assays against the human adenosine A3 receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Adenosine A3 receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return one row per compound with columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles, sorted by compound_chembl_id.
